allergy_note.title: Allergy alert
allergy_note.text: Our products may contain or may have trace amounts of peanuts, tree nuts, soy, or dairy.

items.question: How can I order?
items.answer: Order online for pickup through our online menu, order delivery via Uber Eats, or visit our Katy store in person. You can also call us at 281-394-2550.

items.question: Do you ship outside the local area?
items.answer: Not yet. We focus on pickup, local delivery, and in-store orders. Shipping is something we are working on.

items.question: What sizes do you offer?
items.answer: Our popcorn comes in bags, tins, and gift boxes, from a 1.5 cup Popcone up to a 275 cup Party Sized option.

items.question: Can I mix my own flavors?
items.answer: Yes. Mix and match your favorite flavors or colors to fit your event or theme. Seasonal flavors may also be available.

items.question: Is your popcorn gluten-free or nut-free?
items.answer: Many flavors are gluten-free, but some contain dairy or nuts. Check our flavor list or ask in-store for allergen details.

items.question: How long does your popcorn stay fresh?
items.answer: Up to 2 to 3 weeks when sealed and stored in a cool, dry place. Our tins help it stay fresh even longer.

items.question: Do you handle events and bulk orders?
items.answer: Absolutely. We offer bulk orders, party favors, and corporate gifting. Contact us for details and a quote.
